6.330 rsInvalidNestedAggregateScope
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidNestedAggregateScope is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function that is
nested in the Expression parameter of another aggregate function specifies a Scope parameter that is
not the name of a Group or DataRegion contained within the Scope parameter that is specified by
the outer aggregate function.
